question.question: List base Vagabond characters with starting items and special action costs/results, including Ranger timing.

expected.expected_answer: Thief boot/torch/tea/sword, exhaust torch Steal random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker boot/torch/bag/hammer, exhaust torch Day Labor matching discard card, bird always valid. Ranger boot/torch/crossbow/sword, exhaust torch Hideout repair three retaining faces, immediately end Daylight for Evening.

source_passages.quotation:
| Base character | Starting items | Special action |
|---|---|---|
| Thief | boot, torch, tea, sword | **Steal:** exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in your clearing |
| Tinker | boot, torch, bag, hammer | **Day Labor:** exhaust torch to take discard-pile card matching clearing; bird always qualifies |

answer.ruling: Starting items: boot, torch, tea, sword. Steal costs exhausting the torch and takes a random hand card from a player with faction pieces in the Vagabond’s clearing.
Starting items: boot, torch, bag, hammer. Day Labor costs exhausting the torch and takes a discard-pile card matching the clearing; a bird card always qualifies.
Starting items: boot, torch, crossbow, sword. Hideout costs exhausting the torch, repairs three items while keeping their faces, then immediately ends Daylight and begins Evening.
